title: File:Namtok Mae Surin, Waterfall 3, Thailand.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Mae Surin Waterfall. Numerous streams and rivers around. A mix of evergreen and deciduous hill forest with some Dipterocarp trees. Namtok Mae Surin, Doi Pui Area, Mae Hong Son Province, Thanon Thong Chai Range, Thailand.
